name: sts2.fun statistics
author: sts2.fun
description: Uploads your finished runs (.run files only) to https://sts2.fun so they count in the community stats, and shows your sts2.fun account on the main menu. With each run it also reports which mods were loaded (names and versions), so runs played with gameplay mods are left out of the stats. Nothing else is read or sent. Turn uploads off by setting "Enabled": false in sts2fun_stats/config.json. Does not affect gameplay.
